007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Team;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013
014/**
015 * Lists teams owned by the connected database user.
016 *
017 * <p>Set {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD}, and
018 * {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL} before running this sample. Optionally set
019 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_NAME_PATTERN} to a database regular expression
020 * for case-insensitive filtering. Granted teams owned by another user are not
021 * listed by this view.</p>
022 */
023public final class ListAgentTeamsSample {
024
025    private ListAgentTeamsSample() {
026    }
027
028    /**
029     * Runs the sample and propagates failures to the command-line caller.
030     *
031     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
032     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails
033     */
034    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
035        try (SelectAIAgent selectAIAgent = createSelectAIAgent()) {
036            String pattern = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_NAME_PATTERN");
037            for (Team team : pattern == null ? selectAIAgent.listTeams() : selectAIAgent.listTeams(pattern)) {
038                System.out.println(team.getTeamName() + ": " + team.getDescription());
039            }
040        }
041    }
042
043    private static SelectAIAgent createSelectAIAgent() throws SelectAIException {
044        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
045                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
046                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
047                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
048                .build());
049    }
050
051    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
052        String value = System.getenv(name);
053        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
054            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
055        }
056        return value;
057    }
058
059    private static String optionalEnv(String name) {
060        String value = System.getenv(name);
061        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
062    }
063}
